concept_uz: Minus Bir oʻz ismidan xafa: «salbiy»manmi? Nol tushuntiradi: salbiy emas — manfiy. Egizaklar quchoqlashadi — puf! — ikkalasi ham yoʻqoladi, chunki 1 + (−1) = 0. Nol sirni biladi: ular uning oʻzida. Uchovlon safarga yoʻl oladi.
format_uz: 12 sahna: gapiradigan sahnalar 6 soniya, hikoyachi sahnalari 10 soniya (~1:40)
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, gentle split light — cool moonlight from the left, warm sunlight from the right — soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round king shaped like a thick, chunky upright ring with a small hole in the middle, so its wide front face is a disc. The ring is coloured like a yin-yang: the left half dark moon-silver with one small bright gold dot, the right half bright sun-gold with one small dark silver dot, the two halves curving into each other in a smooth S-shaped wave — made of polished metal, not a flat printed symbol. Big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast low-poly crystal plain, exactly where the cool left side meets the warm right side, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on the vast low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty low-poly crystal plain made of smooth faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue facets on the left, warm amber facets on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the ground from left to right through the centre. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars on the left, where a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face smiles; warm morning light on the right, where a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling eyes, bushy eyebrows and a beard of rays — smiles back. Not dark, just a gentle difference between the two sides. No characters.

Put these three characters together on this crystal plain: the yin-yang ring-king exactly in the centre, the gold twin one step away on the RIGHT side of the picture (the warm sun side) and the silver twin with the dark-blue sash one step away on the LEFT side of the picture (the cool moon side). All three face the camera, full body, the twins not touching each other. Keep every character design exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: A self-contained 6-second shot. On the crystal plain the silver twin with the dark-blue sash stands on the left side of the picture, tugging at the robe of the yin-yang ring-king in the centre; the gold twin watches from the right. The silver twin with the dark-blue sash says in Uzbek with a low, raspy, sulky voice of a grumpy ten-year-old boy, slow, with a sigh — sulky, looking up at the king: "Aybim nima, qirolim," Then, hurt, pointing at its own dark-blue sash: "Tamg'a qo'ydingiz «salbiy»." Delivery: natural dialogue that happens to rhyme, not sing-song, with a short breath between the two lines. Lip-sync: only the silver twin with the dark-blue sash moves its mouth and speaks, one line at a time, never two voices at once; every other character keeps its mouth closed; no background voices or murmur. Sound: a small cloth tug and a soft sad little woodwind note; no background music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

A self-contained 6-second shot. On the crystal plain the yin-yang ring-king kneels down to the height of the silver twin with the dark-blue sash on the left side of the picture; the gold twin watches from the right. The yin-yang ring-king says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, slightly theatrical baritone voice of a kind middle-aged king, slow, with dramatic pauses — warmly, shaking his head kindly: "Yo'q-yo'q, sening aybing yo'q," Then, gently tapping the silver twin's sash, with a reassuring smile: "Salbiy emassan, manfiy!" The silver twin's frown melts into a shy smile. Delivery: natural dialogue that happens to rhyme, not sing-song, with a short breath between the two lines. Lip-sync: only the yin-yang ring-king moves its mouth and speaks, one line at a time, never two voices at once; every other character keeps its mouth closed; no background voices or murmur. Sound: a soft warm chime on the tap; no background music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.
